messages:
marta: Quick sanity check — I spun up vectra-small-v2 on the embed holdout. Short queries look close to baseline but long queries have a clear drop.
ian: Can you paste the numbers and the baseline for comparison?
marta: Sure. Holdout recall@1/5/10
- vectra-small-v1 (baseline): short 0.74 / 0.88 / 0.92, long 0.69 / 0.82 / 0.88
- vectra-small-v2 (new):       short 0.72 / 0.86 / 0.91, long 0.56 / 0.75 / 0.83
marta: So short queries ~2pt down, long queries ~13pt down at @1. Big disparity.
cheng: Did you test any quantized variants? int8 per-tensor vs per-channel can shift long-query geometry.
marta: Yes — quick run:
```
$ python eval.py --model vectra-small-v2 --holdout holdout_long.json --k 10 --quant none
recall@1 0.56
recall@5 0.75
recall@10 0.83
$ python eval.py --model vectra-small-v2 --quant int8_pt --holdout holdout_long.json --k 10
recall@1 0.49
recall@5 0.67
recall@10 0.78
$ python eval.py --model vectra-small-v2 --quant int8_pc --holdout holdout_long.json --k 10
recall@1 0.52
recall@5 0.70
recall@10 0.79
```
marta: int8 makes long queries worse, but still there is a gap even without quant.
eva: What's different in v2 arch/finetune? pooling? training data distribution? length bias?
marta: v2 switched to mean pooling over last 4 layers vs v1 CLS token. Also we added more short-query augmentation in finetune (more paraphrases).
sam: That would explain short-query parity and long-query drop — representation collapsed for long contexts.
ian: Can we check embedding norms and angle distribution by length? also silhouette for cluster-quality on long-query holdout.
marta: Ran a quick probe. eval-bot: generated diagnostics
```
EVAL-BOT: vectra-small-v2 long-holdout diagnostics
- mean norm (short queries): 12.3
- mean norm (long queries): 7.9
- cos-sim (within positive pairs long): 0.42
- cos-sim (random negatives long): 0.18
- silhouette (clusters, long): 0.21
- silhouette (clusters, short): 0.33
```
marta: Norm collapse on long queries — embeddings are smaller magnitude and clusters weaker.
cheng: Try L2-normalize post-encode before scoring as a quick test; if it helps, it's a representation scale issue
eva: Also try truncation ablation: run v1 pooling with v2 encoder outputs (swap pooling) to isolate pooling vs encoder change.
sam: For ANN recall, adjust hnsw efSearch to 200 for long queries — you might recover a couple pts if it's approximate search miss.
marta: Quick efSearch sweep (k=10): efSearch 50 => recall@1 0.56, efSearch 100 => 0.58, efSearch 200 => 0.59
marta: So ANN tuning helps small amount but doesn't close the gap.
ian: Next steps: (1) run v2-with-CLS pooling ablation, (2) run post-L2-normalize scoring, (3) retrain finetune with more long-query augmentations, (4) quantify layer-avg vs CLS correlation.
marta: I'll kick off (1) and (2) now and post numbers. If results are positive, we can decide whether to keep v2 encoder + CLS or revert pooling.
eva: Also add a small clustering visualization (UMAP) to the ticket — long-query cluster overlap looks suspicious.
marta: noted. will update by EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
